content: Boom! The 2026 American Football League schedule is official, and I'm told the league office earned its paycheck on this one. Two hundred and four games. Fourteen weeks. Three doubleheaders -- Weeks 1, 2 and 12 -- and not one of them lands on an NFL bye. Every franchise is looking at the same sheet of paper. Four games on it are going to define the season.

Start at the top. Week 1: Dicks out for Harambe at The Boondock Saints. Opening week, doubleheader week, and the cross-conference opener. You get this one before anybody knows what their roster actually is, and it counts exactly as much as the ones in December. League sources tell me that is the whole idea.

Week 2: Computer Jocks at Vitside Mafia. Division rivalry, doubleheader week, and it lands while half the league is still figuring out its flex. The Jocks also open Week 1 at Jewpacabra, so they are two games into the season and already twice into the deep end.

Week 5: The Mariachi Ninjas at Jewpacabra. Two of last year's best, dropped into the middle of the schedule with no doubleheader around it to soften the landing. One game, one week, full weight. This is the one that tells you who is actually contending and who was just early.

And then Week 14. Smokane FC at Suh girls, one cup, with a division title on the line in the final week. These two have met 34 times and are dead even at 17-17. Thirty-four games, seventeen apiece. You could not build that on purpose -- and the schedule hands it to you as the last thing that happens all season. Circle it now.

The nice part is they meet twice. Suh girls, one cup at Smokane FC comes all the way back in Week 2, twelve weeks before the rematch. Split them and the whole thing comes down to the final Sunday anyway. That is the shape of this entire schedule: no two division rivals meet twice inside eight weeks of each other, so nobody settles a feud in September.

The rest of the renewals are stacked. Fullybaked at Drunk Indians in Week 1 -- 38 meetings, Fullybaked up 22-16. Drunk Indians at Smokane FC in Week 2 -- 42 meetings, Smokane FC up 24-18. The Boondock Saints at A Bruin Pegs Me in Week 2 -- 29 meetings, A Bruin Pegs Me up 15-14. Titsburgh Feelers at The Mariachi Ninjas in Week 4 -- 31 meetings, the Ninjas up 17-14. Vitside Mafia at Smokane FC in Week 5 -- 20 meetings, dead even at 10-10. Fullybaked at Vitside Mafia in Week 11 -- 22 meetings, Fullybaked up 12-10. Suh girls, one cup at Midwestside Connection in Week 11 -- 23 meetings, Suh girls, one cup up 12-11. Ninety-seven pairings on this schedule have met six times or more. This league remembers.

Now the part nobody wants to read and everybody wants to be true: the draw is fair. Eighty-four of a possible eighty-four division games fall in weeks with no NFL byes -- that is the ceiling, not a good try. Bye-week luck runs a gap of two between the most and least favored franchise. Home games run eight to nine per team. If you lose a division game this year, you lose it on your roster. Not on the calendar. Check the Gauntlet rankings if you want to argue with that.

Week 14 is all division, top to bottom -- twelve games, every one of them a rivalry, every division decided on the same day. No tiebreakers you have to explain to somebody. No coin flips. Just games. Put the dates in the league calendar and start building around them.
It begins in Week 1 with Dicks out for Harambe at The Boondock Saints. Everything else flows from there. The full schedule, week by week, is on the schedule release page.
